title: Armstrong's records and current clarinet players
summary: He likes all Armstrong periods and praises Louis Cottrell on clarinet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: We were talking about favorite records. Let's see. You said you liked Lewis, and you liked spirituals? Yeah. And who else?
That's about it. That's about it.
What do you think was Lewis' greatest period for records? Do you like the Hot Five records, or do you like the big bands, or do you like any one more than others?
More about the same. The Hot Five was great. The big band was great. The band here today is great. So you like it all? I actually do. And he knows it.
You know, you named some of your favorite trumpet players before we were talking about.
Oh, I can tell you, I don't know. Lewis, but I mean, one that I really always did like. Lewis, and the rest of them is all good with me. I like all the trumpet players.
What about the clarinet players now? Down here I'm talking about New Orleans. Yeah, I know, Shireen.

Well, they've got some good clarinet players. I like some, and they've got a lot of them that many fellas don't speak of. It's really wonderful. See, Contrell, he's a wonderful man on the clarinet. See, I don't hear much talk about him, but it's there. So they're great with me.
